about: License data that crate packages lack or misstate, read by scripts/release.py when it writes THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt (D-122, docs/releases.md). Each entry holds for one crate version: when the graph moves the crate to another, check upstream again, refresh the files and update `version`. `texts` replaces the license texts the package lacks, `bundled` lists works the crate compiles in under another license than its own, and `fonts_reviewed` says why the package's font files never reach a binary. Files sit under licenses/, fetched upstream at the commit `source` names.

crates.name: dasp_sample
crates.why: The package has no license file.

crates.name: gilrs
crates.why: The package has no license file of its own (.cargo_vcs_info.json names gilrs commit 07e286e24b046cf39e5c367daa2770b805a64692, whose root holds LICENSE-MIT). build.rs filters SDL_GameControllerDB/gamecontrollerdb.txt for the target platform and src/mapping/mod.rs compiles the result in through include_str!; the database is SDL_GameControllerDB's, under zlib, while the crate's metadata says Apache-2.0/MIT. Its licence text is the package's SDL_GameControllerDB/LICENSE, a submodule at that commit.

crates.name: sctk-adwaita
crates.why: src/title/ab_glyph_renderer.rs compiles in src/title/Cantarell-Regular.ttf through include_bytes!; the font is byte-equal to ttf/Cantarell-Regular.ttf at Cantarell's tag 0.0.5, while the crate's metadata and its LICENSE say MIT. Its COPYING is stored with LF line endings.
